title: MIDA: Multi-Interest Decoding with Adaptive Aggregation for Session-based Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34192v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Session-based recommendation (SBR) infers user interest from limited interaction sequences, yet current models show a consistent performance drop when longer histories are available. This degradation is associated with decoder designs that overemphasize recent items while underutilizing distant, yet semantically relevant, interactions, leading to poor modeling of long-range dependencies and multi-interest behaviors. To address this challenge, we introduce MIDA (Multi-Interest Decoding with Adaptive Aggregation for Session-based Recommendation), a lightweight and encoder-agnostic framework that provides a reformulation of the decoding stage. The central design principle is a two-space decoupling: clustering operates on raw item embeddings so that semantic groupings are not distorted by encoder-learned relational biases; encoder outputs are reserved for aggregation, where sequential context remains intact. translated_title: MIDA：面向基于会话推荐的多兴趣解码与自适应聚合
translated_abstract: 基于会话的推荐（SBR）旨在从有限的交互序列中推断用户兴趣，然而当更长的历史记录可用时，现有模型却出现一致的性能下降。这种退化与解码器设计有关：这些设计过度强调近期物品，同时低估了远距离但语义相关的交互，导致对长程依赖和多兴趣行为的建模不佳。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了MIDA（Multi-Interest Decoding with Adaptive Aggregation for Session-based Recommendation），一个轻量级且与编码器无关的框架，对解码阶段进行了重新设计。其核心设计原则是双空间解耦：聚类在原始物品嵌入上进行，使语义分组不会被编码器学习到的关系偏差所扭曲；编码器输出则保留用于聚合，从而保持序列上下文的完整性。具体而言，MIDA（i）采用diff……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出MIDA框架，通过双空间解耦设计（在原始物品嵌入上聚类、利用编码器输出进行聚合）重构解码阶段，解决了基于会话推荐中过度关注近期物品、忽视远距离语义相关交互的问题。
en_tdlr: MIDA reformulates the decoding stage of session-based recommendation through a two-space decoupling—clustering on raw item embeddings while reserving encoder outputs for aggregation—to address the overemphasis on recent items and underutilization of distant yet semantically relevant interactions.
